sources.note: Main homepage. Describes StrateqEHR as cloud-native HIS for critical access/rural hospitals and freestanding ERs. Names ADHS and Nutex Health as customers. Mentions founding since 1983 (via parent group), Houston TX base.

ONC mandatory disclosures page. Lists StrateqEHR v5 certification, 35+ certified functionalities, third-party software dependencies (FDB, Aspyra CyberLAB, Bridge Patient Portal, NewCrop), additional costs, and eight CQMs.

Clinical solutions page. Details patient dashboard, Dynamic Form Engine for clinical documentation, CPOE (close-loop), nursing workflows (care plans, eMAR, Kardex), ED tracking board/triage, pharmacy with FDB/SureScripts, perioperative module, HIM/medical records.
Solutions overview. Organizes product into four areas: Clinical Solutions, Revenue Cycle, Ancillary Solutions, Freestanding ER. Limited detail on this landing page.

Freestanding ER page. Details ED tracking board (location, ESI, vitals, orders), close-loop CPOE with complaint-specific order sets, ED nursing templates, eMAR, discharge with ePrescribing, ED daily log and turnaround time reporting.

Revenue cycle page. Describes Waystar integration for claims, real-time eligibility, 3M CRS coding, electronic remittance, denial management, patient statements, credit card processing, GL journal entries, comprehensive financial reporting.

About page. Lists co-founders Datuk Tan Seng Kit (CEO) and CheeSiong Yee (COO/CTO). Small leadership team of ~6 named individuals. Claims 'redefining industries since 1983.' Strategic partners include AWS, ARMOR, Waystar.

Parent company Strateq Group page. Reveals Strateq Health is part of a Malaysia-based conglomerate with offices across Asia and USA. References '37 Degrees' as their cloud HIS and 'FiSiCien' as another product. Claims 22+ years in healthcare IT, 30+ hospital deployments internationally.

2019 GlobeNewsWire press release about Strateq Health and ARMOR partnership. Cites 600+ employees globally, 30+ years development experience. Describes integrated clinical, revenue cycle, and financial applications. Showcased at TORCH 2019 conference in Dallas.
